name: caaci-site
description: Rebuild of caaciorg.com on Cloudflare Pages + Supabase

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && node build.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:push: node -e "console.error('db:push is disabled. The live Supabase project has no migration history table, so the CLI would replay every migration from 0001_init.sql against production. Paste new migrations into the Supabase SQL editor, in filename order: see Applying migrations in SETUP.md.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.db:seed: node -e "console.error('db:seed is disabled. On the live project seed.sql resets every membership tier name, price and description to the values in the file. See Applying migrations in SETUP.md.'); process.exit(1)"
